Name: Official Xbox Magazine: Volume 116: December 2010
Overview:
Official Xbox Magazine (OXM) Demo Disc #116 shipped to subscribers in October 2010 (bearing the cover date of December 2010 for Issue 116). Formatted natively for Xbox 360 hardware, Disc #116 featured high-definition 360 playable game demos, Xbox Live Arcade (XLA) trials, custom downloadable content, and exclusive media previews:

Need for Speed: Hot Pursuit (arcade racing)
Splatterhouse (hack-and-slash beat 'em up)
Majin and the Forsaken Kingdom (action-adventure puzzle)
Ilomilo (Xbox Live Arcade 3D puzzle-platformer)
Raskulls (Xbox Live Arcade action puzzle-platformer)
Deadest Nation (Xbox Live Arcade top-down twin-stick shooter)

In addition to interactive gameplay, the native 360 disc included downloadable gamerpics, offline backward-compatibility emulation updates, and high-definition 720p/1080i video previews--featuring coverage for Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim, Mass Effect 3, and Gears of War 3, alongside OXM's monthly Review Roundup and Top Plays segment.
